channel.title: Style Journal by Farnaz Sadeghian
channel.description: A new interior style every day, by Dubai interior decorator Farnaz Sadeghian.

item.title: Japandi vs Scandinavian: The Real Differences and How to Choose
item.dc:creator: Farnaz Sadeghian
item.description: Both are calm, natural and practical, so why do they feel so different? A clear side-by-side of Japandi and Scandinavian style, and how to choose the right one for your room.

item.title: Mid-Century Modern Interior Style: How to Get the Warm, Timeless Look at Home
item.dc:creator: Farnaz Sadeghian
item.description: Walnut, tapered legs, curved chairs and a touch of mustard and orange. What defines mid-century modern style, and how to bring it into a modern home without it looking retro.

item.title: Scandinavian Interior Style: How to Create a Light, Warm and Simple Home
item.dc:creator: Farnaz Sadeghian
item.description: Pale wood, soft white walls, wool and linen, and nothing you don't need. Here is what makes Scandinavian style feel so calm, and how to use it in a sunny apartment.

item.title: Persian Interior Style: How to Bring Its Warmth Into a Modern Home
item.dc:creator: Farnaz Sadeghian
item.description: Rich rugs, jewel tones, arches and the art of hospitality. What defines Persian interior style, and how to use it in a modern apartment without it feeling like a museum.

item.title: Moroccan Interior Style: How to Bring Riad Warmth, Tile and Lantern Light Home
item.dc:creator: Farnaz Sadeghian
item.description: Zellige tiles, soft plaster walls, lantern light and rugs in spice colours. What defines Moroccan style, and how to use it in a modern home without turning it into a souk.

item.title: Japandi Interior Style: How to Get the Calm, Warm Minimal Look at Home
item.dc:creator: Farnaz Sadeghian
item.description: Japanese calm meets Scandinavian comfort: low furniture, warm wood, earthy colours and handmade pieces. How to create a Japandi room that feels peaceful, not empty.
